data.summary: This data partition directory (dt=2026-01-29) contains structured CSV data tables representing an e-commerce data warehouse snapshot. The files include customers, products, orders, and order items along with a success flag file, capturing core transactional and dimensional records for analysis.

file_insights.name: _SUCCESS
file_insights.summary: Marker file indicating successful completion of the data pipeline for the partition.
file_insights.source_summary: Empty success flag file indicating successful partition loading.
file_insights.detailed_description: Indicates successful execution of the batch or data pipeline task for the date partition dt=2026-01-29.

file_insights.name: customers.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores customer profile and membership tier information partitioned by date.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV table schema featuring customer_id, name, city, membership_tier, changed_at, event_id, and is_deleted fields.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains customer entity records including customer ID, name, city, membership tier, change timestamps, event IDs, and soft-delete flags for data tracking.
responsibilities: Store customer demographic and membership data
Track record changes and event IDs
Support customer data warehousing and analytics

file_insights.name: order_items.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores line item details for customer orders including quantity and unit price.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV table schema featuring order_item_id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price, changed_at, event_id, and is_deleted fields.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains detailed line items for customer orders, linking orders to products with quantities, unit prices, event IDs, and change tracking timestamps.
responsibilities: Track product quantities and unit prices per order

file_insights.name: orders.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores customer order headers and their lifecycle statuses.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV table schema featuring order_id, customer_id, order_status, ordered_at, changed_at, event_id, and is_deleted fields.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains transactional order records including order status, order timestamps, customer references, event IDs, and change tracking.
responsibilities: Store order header information and lifecycle status
Track order creation and modification timestamps

file_insights.name: products.csv
file_insights.summary: Stores the product catalog details including pricing and categories.
file_insights.source_summary: CSV table schema featuring product_id, name, category, price, changed_at, event_id, and is_deleted fields.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains product catalog information including product names, categories, pricing, event IDs, and update timestamps.
responsibilities: Support order item calculations and catalog analysis
